question: For order 423, identify the product IDs, aisles, and positions from which to pick the exact quantities needed for each order line, ensuring that the total picked quantity for each product matches the cumulative quantities ordered without exceeding the available inventory in warehouse 1. Calculate the quantities to be picked from each location by prioritizing inventory with earlier purchased dates and smaller quantities, and ensure that picking respects the sequence and cumulative quantities of the order lines for products with multiple entries.
sql:
WITH order_products AS (
    SELECT product_id, SUM(qty) AS total_needed
    FROM orderlines 
    WHERE order_id = 423
    GROUP BY product_id
),
inventory_sorted AS (
    SELECT inv.id, inv.product_id, inv.purchase_id, inv.qty, inv.location_id, p.purchased, l.warehouse, l.aisle, l.position,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY inv.product_id ORDER BY p.purchased, inv.qty, inv.id) AS rn
    FROM inventory inv
    JOIN purchases p ON inv.purchase_id = p.id
    JOIN locations l ON inv.location_id = l.id
    WHERE l.warehouse = 1
      AND inv.product_id IN (SELECT product_id FROM order_products)
),
with_cum AS (
    SELECT inv.*, op.total_needed,
           SUM(inv.qty) OVER (PARTITION BY inv.product_id ORDER BY inv.rn ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS cum_qty,
           COALESCE(SUM(inv.qty) OVER (PARTITION BY inv.product_id ORDER BY inv.rn ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING), 0) AS prev_cum
    FROM inventory_sorted inv
    JOIN order_products op ON inv.product_id = op.product_id
)
SELECT product_id, aisle, position, 
       CASE 
           WHEN prev_cum >= total_needed THEN 0
           WHEN prev_cum + qty <= total_needed THEN qty
           ELSE total_needed - prev_cum
       END AS qty_to_pick
FROM with_cum
WHERE prev_cum < total_needed
ORDER BY product_id, rn

WITH order_products AS (
    SELECT product_id, SUM(qty) AS total_needed
    FROM orderlines 
    WHERE order_id = 423
    GROUP BY product_id
),
inventory_sorted AS (
    SELECT inv.id, inv.product_id, inv.purchase_id, inv.qty, inv.location_id, p.purchased, l.warehouse, l.aisle, l.position,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY inv.product_id ORDER BY p.purchased, inv.qty, inv.id) AS rn
    FROM inventory inv
    JOIN purchases p ON inv.purchase_id = p.id
    JOIN locations l ON inv.location_id = l.id
    WHERE l.warehouse = 1
      AND inv.product_id IN (SELECT product_id FROM order_products)
),
with_cum AS (
    SELECT inv.*, op.total_needed,
           SUM(inv.qty) OVER (PARTITION BY inv.product_id ORDER BY inv.rn ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS cum_qty,
           COALESCE(SUM(inv.qty) OVER (PARTITION BY inv.product_id ORDER BY inv.rn ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING), 0) AS prev_cum
    FROM inventory_sorted inv
    JOIN order_products op ON inv.product_id = op.product_id
)
SELECT product_id, aisle, position, 
       CASE 
           WHEN prev_cum >= total_needed THEN 0
           WHEN prev_cum + qty <= total_needed THEN qty
           ELSE total_needed - prev_cum
       END AS qty_to_pick
FROM with_cum
WHERE prev_cum < total_needed
ORDER BY product_id, rn
